logline: A home-makeover show: Pochettino arrives at the crumbling 18th-placed house of Man United promising 'give me time' — every fix knocks something else down, and his first job, Anfield, is a wrecking ball: 4-0.

8': a brick 'YORO' falls (red); then four swings 10', 13', 66', 82' — LIV 4-0
Pochettino in the rubble, hard hat askew, still holding 'GIVE ME TIME'; next: Sporting, Wed
